title: Compulsory admission (MHO Forms 1–3)
stem: Hong Kong A&E. Mr Lee, 35, was brought in by police after standing in traffic shouting that the government is controlling his thoughts through the traffic lights. He refuses to stay. His mother is here. Assess him and explain how you would arrange admission if needed.
notes:
Checked against the Mental Health Ordinance (Cap 136, Hong Kong), Part III (Sections 30–36) and the Hospital Authority procedures.

Voluntary admission is preferred when he consents and has capacity (age 16 or over; under 16 via parent or guardian). Compulsory admission for observation (Section 31): the patient is suffering from mental disorder of a nature or degree warranting detention in a mental hospital for observation (with or without treatment) for a limited period, and it is necessary for his own health or safety or the protection of others.

Forms: Form 1 — application by a relative, a registered medical practitioner, or a Social Welfare Department officer, who has seen the patient within the previous 14 days; Form 2 — written medical opinion by a registered medical practitioner who examined the patient within the previous 7 days; Form 3 — order by a District Judge or Magistrate, authorising detention for up to 7 days. The patient is told of his right to see the District Judge/Magistrate. Extension (Section 32, Form 4): two medical practitioners, up to 21 days. Section 36 for longer detention.

This follows your notes, which appear accurate; confirm current form numbering and practice with your hospital's MHO guide, as I could not check the full current Ordinance text.

opts.t: What happened? Any weapons, violence or drugs?
opts.mark: Takes collateral history and checks safety
opts.r: Officer: Standing in the road shouting at cars for an hour. No weapon. Pushed an officer once. We found no drugs.

opts.t: Please stay nearby while I talk to him

steps.label: Assess Mr Lee
steps.hint: Rapport, psychotic symptoms, risk to self and others, drugs, insight, physical causes.

Beliefs.t: Can you tell me what was happening in the road?
Beliefs.tz: 你可唔可以話我知，頭先喺馬路發生咩事？
Beliefs.rz: 啲交通燈一轉色就傳訊息入我個腦。我要截停佢哋。
Beliefs.r: The lights change to send messages into my head. I have to stop them.

Beliefs.t: Do you hear voices when no one is there?
Beliefs.tz: 冇人喺度嗰陣，你會唔會聽到有人同你講嘢？
Beliefs.rz: 佢哋叫我行出馬路，擋住啲訊號。
Beliefs.r: They tell me to go into the road and block the signals.

Risk.t: Have you thought of harming yourself or anyone else?
Risk.tz: 你有冇諗過傷害自己或者其他人？
Risk.rz: 如果啲聲叫我做，我就要做。
Risk.r: If the voices tell me to, I'll do what I have to.
Risk.mark: Assesses risk to self and others

Risk.tz: 有冇用藥物或者飲酒？身體有冇其他病？
Risk.rz: 冇用藥物。幾個月前我停咗食藥。
Risk.r: No drugs. I stopped my medicine months ago.

Insight.t: Do you think you might be unwell? Would you stay in hospital?
Insight.tz: 你覺唔覺得自己可能唔舒服？肯唔肯留喺醫院？

steps.label: Talk to his mother
steps.hint: Background, previous illness, treatment, recent change.

Collateral.t: Has he been unwell like this before?
Collateral.rz: 佢有精神分裂，入過兩次青山醫院。四個月前佢停咗打針。
Collateral.r: He has schizophrenia. Admitted to Castle Peak twice. He stopped his injections 4 months ago.

Collateral.t: Would you be willing to be the applicant?
Collateral.tz: 你願唔願意做申請人，申請佢入院？
Collateral.rz: 如果可以保護到佢，我願意。
Collateral.r: If it keeps him safe, yes.

steps.ask: Thank you. Please explain the admission process to me.
steps.label: Explain the process
steps.hint: Try voluntary first; grounds; Forms 1, 2, 3; rights.

opts.t: Grounds: mental disorder warranting detention for observation, necessary for his health or safety or others' protection
Form 1: application by his mother (relative), who has seen him within 14 days
Form 2: medical opinion by a registered medical practitioner who examined him within 7 days
opts.mark: Form 2 medical opinion and time limit

opts.t: Form 3: order by a District Judge or Magistrate for up to 7 days; tell him of his right to see the judge
opts.mark: Form 3 order, 7-day limit, and his rights

opts.t: Detain him under the Ordinance on my own signature for 21 days
opts.r: A single doctor cannot detain for 21 days; the process needs the application, a medical opinion and a judicial order.

qs.a: A relative, a registered medical practitioner, or an SWD officer

qs.q: Maximum detention under a Section 31 order?

qs.a: Form 4, two doctors, up to 21 days
wrong: One doctor's certificate, for up to 1 year

qs.q: Which is part of the Section 31 grounds?
qs.a: Detention is needed for his or others' safety
wrong: He refused his medication once last week
He is intoxicated with alcohol tonight
He is homeless and has no one to care for him

qs.a: Voices instructing the person to act
wrong: Voices commenting on the person's actions
Smells that no one else in the room can detect

badge.name: Cap 136
badge.flavor: Voluntary first. Grounds, Form 1, Form 2, Form 3, rights.

cards.q: MHO Section 31 order lasts up to…
Form 1 applicant must have seen the patient within…
First option for a capable patient needing admission?

options: Persistent low mood with early waking

cards.q: The patient under Section 31 has the right to…
options: See the District Judge or Magistrate
Leave the hospital whenever he wishes after 24 hours
cards.why: He must be informed of his rights.
